items.headline: New ban on inducements starts 20 November
items.whats_changing: Providers must not give or offer gifts or benefits that are likely to win or keep participants. Genuine discounts and your own merchandise are exceptions.
items.what_to_do: Review any sign-up offers, referral gifts or promotions, and check whether this applies to you.

items.headline: Reminder: 90-day claim window starts 1 December
items.whats_changing: Claims must be made within 90 days of delivering a support, down from 2 years. The new law sets the start date as 1 December 2026.
items.who_it_affects: All providers and plan managers who claim from NDIS plans
items.what_to_do: Check your invoicing routine so claims go in soon after each support is delivered.

items.headline: Reminder: four price limits rise on 1 December
items.whats_changing: Maximum prices rise for house cleaning, house or yard maintenance, personal domestic activities, and specialised home-based help for a child. Item numbers and claiming don't change.
items.who_it_affects: Providers who claim any of these four items
items.what_to_do: Check the new limits, and agree any service agreement price changes with participants first.

items.headline: Digital platforms: worker screening rules start 1 January
items.whats_changing: Workers need a valid worker screening clearance before offering supports on an NDIS digital platform. Platforms must also check and show banning orders and qualifications.
items.who_it_affects: NDIS digital platforms and the workers who use them
items.what_to_do: If you run a platform or find work through one, check clearances are in place before January.
